notes: No saying of the Prophet is reported: the text is Abd al-Razzaq's note. It names Ikrima narrating to Ibn Abbas and Abu Hurayra, and Abd al-Razzaq reading a book of Hisham and Ma'mar reading to him, but no chain carries a saying, so no route is written (rule 10).

No saying of the Prophet is reported: the text is Abd al-Razzaq's note. It names Ikrima narrating to Ibn Abbas and Abu Hurayra, and Abd al-Razzaq reading a book of Hisham and Ma'mar reading to him, but no chain carries a saying, so no route is written (rule 10).
the report has no compiler's chain: it is Ikrima's remark that he told Ibn Abbas and Abu Hurayra, who said it was true
then Abd al-Razzaq's first-person note that he found it in Hisham's book and went to Mu'ammar, who read it to him («فقرأ على»)
whether this implicit transmission is a chain, and which links it carries, is not settled by the rules (rule 11: first-person narrative with implicit transmission); groups left empty
